corrections.reason: Amharic pronoun 'እሱንም' (6th order እ) was misread as 'አሱንም' (1st order አ).
Traditional Amharic Andemta gloss for 'ለእለ ዓሠርናሆሙ' (those who were invited) is 'ለደግናቸው' (from ደገነ, to invite to a feast), where 'ግ' was misread as 'ም'.
Wait: in the image it is clearly printed 'ጽንፌ ጽልመት' (the outer darkness, Matt 22:13), where 6th-order 'ን' was misread as 'ሩ' ('ጽሩፌ').
